title: CabinetOS Tool Extension manifest
description: tool.json: a Tool Extension's manifest (docs/tool-extensions.md). The window reads it strictly: an unknown key, a missing key or a bad value stops the tool.

id.description: 1 to 63 lower case letters, digits and -, starting with a letter. It must be the folder's name, and it becomes the tool's virtual host name (<id>.tool.cabinetos.example).

name.description: The name the editor tab shows beside a green dot.

entry.description: The page the tool starts from: an .html file inside the tool's folder, such as index.html.

accepts.description: The file names the tool opens: *.ext patterns or exact names, compared without case. Enter on such a file opens it in the tool.

placement.description: pane: a pane's editor tab (design view D). dock: the Tool Dock; this version opens it in a pane too.
